copy.tagline: 测试 golden man 构建版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证 golden man 构建的正确性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden man build

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按技能里收录的 man 手册内容回答 golden_man_single 构建下的命令问题,目前包含 1 个 man page(curl),能给出选项说明和示例。
howto.when: 当你需要查 golden_man_single 命令行工具的语法、选项或示例时触发;原文写明它用于测试 man golden build。

say.text: curl 的 -s 选项是什么意思?
say.note: 会返回该 man page 里的选项说明

say.text: 给我看 curl 的 man page 示例命令
这个构建里收录了哪些 man page?
say.note: 目前只有 curl 一个

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude answers golden_man_single command questions from the bundled man pages. It currently holds 1 man page (curl) and can give option descriptions and examples.
howto.when_en: Use when you need the syntax, options, or examples of golden_man_single command-line tools; the source says it is for testing the man golden build.

say_en.text: What does the -s option for curl do?
say_en.note: Returns the option description from the man page

say_en.text: Show me the man page example for curl
say_en.note: Returns the single example curl https://example.com

say_en.text: Which man pages ship in this build?
